title: Add left and right arrow keys to the window preview's media control buttons
line: The Task Manager's window tooltip now has seek back and seek forward buttons that jump 5 seconds in the playing media.
explanation: This was a missing feature: the media row in the Task Manager's window tooltip (PlayerController.qml) only had Previous, Play/Pause and Next, so going back a few seconds meant opening the player, even though libkmpris already exposes canSeek and Seek(). The change adds two buttons around Play/Pause that call Seek(-5 s) and Seek(+5 s), the same step as the Media Player widget's arrow keys; they only appear when the player reports CanSeek and their icons flip in right-to-left layouts like the skip buttons.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: Add seek buttons to the tooltip media controls

The tooltip's media row only had Previous, Play/Pause and Next, so going
back a few seconds meant opening the player. Add seek buttons around
Play/Pause that move 5 seconds, shown only when the player can seek.

BUG: 528349

patches.diff:
From 8992db451134681c9b039a7c2560ae6537f8a76f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 13:53:42 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/taskmanager: Add seek buttons to the tooltip media
 controls

The tooltip's media row only had Previous, Play/Pause and Next, so going
back a few seconds meant opening the player. Add seek buttons around
Play/Pause that move 5 seconds, shown only when the player can seek.

BUG: 528349
---
 applets/taskmanager/qml/PlayerController.qml | 12 ++++++++++++
 1 file changed, 12 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/qml/PlayerController.qml b/applets/taskmanager/qml/PlayerController.qml
index ebe029f36d..3015fe60ca 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/qml/PlayerController.qml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/qml/PlayerController.qml
@@ -72,6 +72,12 @@ RowLayout {
         onClicked: toolTipDelegate.playerData.Previous()
     }
 
+    PlasmaComponents3.ToolButton {
+        visible: toolTipDelegate.playerData?.canSeek ?? false
+        icon.name: mirrored ? "media-seek-forward" : "media-seek-backward"
+        onClicked: toolTipDelegate.playerData.Seek(-5000000)
+    }
+
     PlasmaComponents3.ToolButton {
         enabled: (root.isPlaying ? toolTipDelegate.playerData?.canPause : toolTipDelegate.playerData?.canPlay) ?? false
         icon.name: root.isPlaying ? "media-playback-pause" : "media-playback-start"
@@ -84,6 +90,12 @@ RowLayout {
         }
     }
 
+    PlasmaComponents3.ToolButton {
+        visible: toolTipDelegate.playerData?.canSeek ?? false
+        icon.name: mirrored ? "media-seek-backward" : "media-seek-forward"
+        onClicked: toolTipDelegate.playerData.Seek(5000000)
+    }
+
     PlasmaComponents3.ToolButton {
         enabled: toolTipDelegate.playerData?.canGoNext ?? false
         icon.name: mirrored ? "media-skip-backward" : "media-skip-forward"
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master: a seekable player's tooltip only has skip back, pause and skip forward
With the fix: skip back, seek back, pause, seek forward, skip forward
Seek back three times, then forward once: the player's clock jumps 5 s each time
A player that can't seek keeps the old three-button row
